title: Community Soda Kiln Firings
source_quote: Burnish holds monthly community soda firings in our dedicated gas reduction soda kiln.
evidence_sentence: The studio holds monthly community soda firings where outside potters purchase space in half-cubic-foot increments.
evidence_quote: Burnish holds monthly community soda firings in our dedicated gas reduction soda kiln.
summary: Purchase space in monthly community soda firings in Burnish's 37-cubic-foot soda kiln. Participants drop work off for loading and firing by studio crew, then pick it up after the unload. Soda firing experience is not required.
bring: bisque-fired work glazed or unglazed, measured in half-cubic-foot increments; height max 12 inches except by prior approval
how_to_join: Click button on page to register through Kiln Fire registration site where current firings are listed quarterly. Waitlist feature available if sold out.
